entries.title: Psalms 103:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, [bless] His holy name!

entries.title: Psalms 103:2
segments: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits:

entries.title: Psalms 103:3
segments: Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases,

entries.title: Psalms 103:4
segments: Who redeems your life from destruction, Who crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies,

entries.title: Psalms 103:5
segments: Who satisfies your mouth with good [things, So that] your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

entries.title: Psalms 103:6
segments: ¶The LORD executes righteousness And justice for all who are oppressed.

entries.title: Psalms 103:7
segments: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the children of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 103:8
segments: The LORD [is] merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 103:9
segments: He will not always strive [with us], Nor will He keep [His anger] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 103:10
segments: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor punished us according to our iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 103:11
segments: For as the heavens are high above the earth, [So] great is His mercy toward those who fear Him;

entries.title: Psalms 103:12
segments: As far as the east is from the west, [So] far has He removed our transgressions from us.

entries.title: Psalms 103:13
segments: As a father pities [his] children, [So] the LORD pities those who fear Him.

entries.title: Psalms 103:14
segments: For He knows our frame; He remembers that we [are] dust.

entries.title: Psalms 103:15
segments: [As for] man, his days [are] like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

entries.title: Psalms 103:16
segments: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone, And its place remembers it no more.

entries.title: Psalms 103:17
segments: But the mercy of the LORD [is] from everlasting to everlasting On those who fear Him, And His righteousness to children's children,

entries.title: Psalms 103:18
segments: To such as keep His covenant, And to those who remember His commandments to do them.

entries.title: Psalms 103:19
segments: ¶The LORD has established His throne in heaven, And His kingdom rules over all.

entries.title: Psalms 103:20
segments: Bless the LORD, you His angels, Who excel in strength, who do His word, Heeding the voice of His word.

entries.title: Psalms 103:21
segments: Bless the LORD, all [you] His hosts, [You] ministers of His, who do His pleasure.

entries.title: Psalms 103:22
segments: Bless the LORD, all His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
